pages.text: A Bee House you wear in the chestplate slot. Its bees work wherever you carry them: biome, weather, light and flowers all come from where you're standing.$(br2)Wander into a better climate and the hive follows.
A Bee House with leather straps, string and an iron buckle.

$(li)$(l)Sneak + right-click$() to put it on.$(li)Press $(k:beemastery.open_hive) to open it while it's on your back.$(li)Right-click it in your hand to open it without wearing it.$(br2)The bees only work while the hive is on your back.
pages.title: Wearing It

pages.text: A basic hive works at a Bee House's pace: a quarter of the bees' own speed. $(l:portable_hive/upgrades)Upgrades$(/l) make it faster, $(l:portable_hive/modules)modules$(/l) change what it can do.
pages.title: How Fast?
